topic: 近一年论文中的具身数据污染问题

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (medium): ‘具身数据污染’尚无稳定统一术语；本轮将偶发的训练—评测泄漏、重复/近重复、预训练基准曝光、错误监督扩散和恶意投毒分开检索。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-direct-data-contamination
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"data contamination" OR all:"benchmark contamination") AND (all:robot OR all:embodied)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 直接检索具身/机器人语境中的数据与基准污染。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-direct-train-test-leakage
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"data leakage" OR all:"train-test leakage" OR all:"test leakage") AND (all:"robot learning" OR all:"embodied AI")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 捕获划分、时间和轨迹级训练—测试泄漏。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-overlap-near-duplicate
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"dataset overlap" OR all:"train-test overlap" OR all:"near-duplicate" OR all:deduplication) AND (all:robot OR all:embodied OR all:egocentric)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检索跨数据集重叠、近重复和去重管道。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-benchmark-exposure-vla
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"benchmark exposure" OR all:"benchmark leakage" OR all:memorization) AND (all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action" OR all:"embodied agent")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检索基础 VLM/LLM 或 VLA 对评测任务的预训练曝光和记忆效应。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-shortcut-overfit-embodied-benchmark
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:shortcut OR all:overfit OR all:memorization) AND (all:"robot benchmark" OR all:"embodied reasoning" OR all:"robotic benchmark")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 寻找被静态协议或传感运动先验掩盖的基准过拟合。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-poisoning-vla-policy
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:poisoning OR all:poisoned OR all:backdoor) AND (all:"robot policy" OR all:"robot learning" OR all:"vision-language-action")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检索示教、预训练 VLA 和下游策略中的恶意污染。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-poisoning
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:poisoning OR all:backdoor) AND (all:robot OR all:robotic)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检索世界模型生成数据供应链的潜伏式污染。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-label-noise-pseudolabel-robot
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"label noise" OR all:"pseudo-label noise" OR all:"noisy demonstrations") AND (all:"robot learning" OR all:"robot manipulation")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检索错误标注、伪标签和混合质量示教如何进入训练集。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-synthetic-feedback-contamination
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"synthetic data" OR all:"generated data") AND (all:contamination OR all:"model collapse" OR all:"feedback loop") AND (all:robot OR all:embodied)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检索生成数据反馈回训造成的系统性污染；仅作邻接证据面。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-governance-provenance-dedup
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:provenance OR all:deduplication OR all:"data governance") AND (all:"robot dataset" OR all:"robot learning")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 寻找可追溯、去重和污染防控工程方案。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-browser-embodied-contamination
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs ("data contamination" OR "train-test leakage" OR "dataset overlap") (robot OR embodied OR VLA)
dynamic_suggestions.why: arXiv API 低召回时用于发现候选论文。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-browser-robot-poisoning
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs (poisoning OR backdoor) ("robot learning" OR "robot policy" OR VLA OR "world model")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 定向发现机器人数据投毒与后门工作。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-calibrate-contamination-terms
dynamic_suggestions.query: embodied AI robot learning data contamination benchmark leakage dataset overlap backdoor poisoning
dynamic_suggestions.why: 检查领域是否已形成新的固定术语或方法名。

calibration_notes: arxiv-web-search calibration (high): 命中具身评测中的 shortcut、overfit 和 static evaluation 术语，仅用于校准查询。
arxiv-web-search calibration (high): 既有候选池显示 robotic policy/VLA 论文使用 backdoor、poisoned data、visual token 等词。
arxiv-web-search calibration (high): 既有候选池显示 world-model data poisoning、robot learning supply chain 是有效检索词。
web-search-error calibration (low): 第二轮实时搜索发生网络错误；保留离线动态扩展并转入 arXiv API 检索。
